name: aee_trade_state_machine_v2
objective: Represent AEE management as explicit phases with minimal deterministic transitions.

states.purpose: Early risk control before durable edge is established.
owned_transitions: PROTECT -> BUILD when progress and quality are sufficient
PROTECT -> PANIC when risk breach is severe

states.purpose: Accumulate green trade while controlling drawdown and decay.
owned_transitions: BUILD -> HARVEST when profit lock criteria are met
BUILD -> PANIC when adverse move exceeds safety backstop

states.purpose: Preserve realized gains while allowing continuation attempts.
owned_transitions: HARVEST -> RUNNER when continuation quality is strong
HARVEST -> PANIC when giveback breach occurs

states.purpose: Let strong trends continue with protective floor.
owned_transitions: RUNNER -> PANIC when hard safety trigger hits

transition_principles: One state owns a narrow transition set
Threshold values are treated as context metrics, not hidden gate stacks
